hypothesis.name: Kneser
evidence: degree_min = degree_max = 252 and C(10,5) = 252, regular = true
spectrum_integral = true with 6 distinct eigenvalues (252, 56, 6, -1, -21, -126), as expected for K(15,5)
board lower = 1001 matches the Erdos-Ko-Rado independent set C(14,4) = 1001, while upper = 1219 from clique_cover is not yet tight

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1001 for 3003 receivers. The lower bound 1001 is a verified independent set; the upper bound is the linear code M = I + A over F_5 (p=5, c=1) of length 1001. It passed code_fits, factorization and decoding. Compared with the baselines: the agent was exact in wall_s 111.1 (compute_s 92.1, llm_s 18.9, 2 LLM calls, 1 critic round). The earlier kushagra_agent was also exact at 1001 in 4.4 s, so the agent is much slower than that rule-based baseline. CP-SAT alpha reached 1001 but was unproven (123.3 s); CP-SAT cover timed out; fractional cover gave 3003.0; F2 minrank SAT gave only 1000. Nothing suspicious.
